correctness.rationale: For all irrational alpha and integers m>=2, the product map is ergodic. The split labels merge into exact base-m digits. The weighted star-label average equals exp(2pi i theta) times the Birkhoff average of exp(-2pi i theta)1_Pstar, whose Haar integral is hat h(1)/m !=0; this recovers the neutral coordinate modulo one. For h(t)=t the exact integral is i/(2pi), giving piecewise affine cells. h(F)=log m, and an m-symbol generator would have uniform independent finite blocks and imply mixing, contradicting the rotation eigenfunction. All quantifiers, null sets, and edge cases are stated; no finite experiment is used for an infinite claim.

The construction attains the entropy-forced minimum plus one simultaneously for every irrational angle, and the Fourier-visible split criterion supplies a reusable family of exact symbolic phase decoders.
